--- original

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M73AX861R80NS7CQV9T52T9Y
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8880'
+title: 'InProcessAgent doc example: give mode: .open to ComposedAgent.compose and projects: to AgentHome.makeCustom'
+---
+## What
+Request of foundationmodelsacpagent-ec (2026-11-10). The doc example in `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/InProcessAgent.swift:19-21` calls `ComposedAgent.compose(name:workingDirectory:home:)` with no `mode:`, and `AgentHome.makeCustom(synced:local:)` with no `projects:`. ACPAgent will remove the temporary `mode` default soon, and `projects:` is already required (ACPAgent c247697).
+
+- [ ] Change the example to the current API, in the argument order of the declarations:
+  - `ComposedAgent.compose(name: …, workingDirectory: projectDirectory, home: …, mode: .open)`. Put `mode:` where the declaration has it; see `IntegrationTests/LiveAgentServer/Sources/graphql-tunnel-server/GraphQLTunnelServer.swift` for the order.
+  - `.makeCustom(synced: syncedFolder, local: localFolder, projects: syncedFolder.appending(path: AgentHome.projectsFolderName, directoryHint: .isDirectory))`, the same as `IntegrationTests/LiveAgentServer/Sources/LiveAgentServerSupport/IntegrationAgentHome.swift:37`.
+- [ ] Do the same check for each other doc example in `Sources/` that calls `ComposedAgent.compose`, `RoutedACPAgent(`, or `makeCustom`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each doc example in `Sources/` that composes an agent gives `mode:` and `projects:` in the order of the declarations.
+- [ ] `swift build` has no new warnings.
+- [ ] The commit goes to foundationmodelsacpagent-ec.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] No behavior changes (a doc comment only), and D156 forbids a test that reads the text of a source file. Thus the check is review and the build.
+- [ ] Run `swift build` and `swift test` → all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #step1
\ No newline at end of file
